items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
notes: No disclosure of pecuniary interest was declared by any member of Council at this point in the meeting.

motions.text: That Council hold a closed meeting for the purposes of considering the following subject matter: a) A matter in respect of which a council, board, committee, or other body may hold a closed meeting under another Act (Municipal Freedom of Information and Protection of Privacy Act) (Safe Drinking Water Act); b) Litigation or potential litigation, including matters before administrative tribunals, affecting the municipality or local board (OLT Update, Safe Drinking Water Act); c) Advice that is subject to solicitor-client privilege, including communications necessary for that purpose (OLT Update, Safe Drinking Water Act); and, d) Personal matters about an identifiable individual, including municipal or local board employees (Safe Drinking Water Act).
